cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

mechanism: A imitates a public expert's behavior incorrectly while demanding recognition as an important contributor.
confusable: D01 seeks need; D09 seeks acknowledged status even without dependence. S04 requires real mistaken imitation.
comparison: Ceremony expertise claim versus backstage public credit.
seedUse: D09-a asks named credit; S04 transforms the basis from actual competence to borrowed ritual.
